configurationTest.title: Configuration availability test
configurationTest.hint: Sends a small sample using each current configuration; local models use the configuration already checked and enabled. Does not save settings or publish knowledge. External calls may incur a small charge. Passing checks API and response availability only.
configurationTest.changed: Configuration changed. Run the test again.
configurationTest.incomplete: Some configuration is incomplete. Complete the fields listed below and retry.
configurationTest.failed: Some stages failed the test. Check the results below.
configurationTest.empty: No model selected: rule extraction and manual processing need no connection test.
configurationTest.passed: All configured models passed the availability test.

automation.configurationHint: Some stages have no model configured. Select a model in preferences.
automation.pausedHint: Check the knowledge capture and automatic processing switches in preferences.
automation.workbenchConfigurationHint: Some stages have no model configured. Select a model in Preferences in the left sidebar.
automation.workbenchPausedHint: Check the knowledge capture and automatic processing switches in Preferences in the left sidebar.
automation.backgroundHint: Project entries and Wiki run in the background while Janus is open. Personal memories need your confirmation.
automation.taskCountsHint: These counts summarize recorded execution outcomes, including history; they are not inbox counts.
automation.title: Knowledge automation
automation.description: Publish project knowledge and Wiki after review. People handle missing evidence, conflicts and model failures. Personal memory remains manually reviewed.
automation.extractionHint: With knowledge capture enabled, basic rule extraction runs automatically without a model. Select a model for additional semantic extraction; turning it off leaves capture and rule extraction running. Candidates still require review before publication.
automation.externalHint: Reuse the configured provider and credentials. Reasoning follows the provider and model; no local service starts.
automation.localHint: Download and verify Qwen and its GPU runtime on first use, or supply existing file paths. Enable only after checks pass. Context follows free VRAM; managed deployment never falls back to CPU. Models load on demand and unload after 3 idle minutes. Empty paths connect to an existing local service, whose GPU configuration is managed externally.
automation.localCheckFailed: Environment check failed; not enabled. Check the executable, weights and service, then retry.
automation.localStopFailed: Disable did not fully complete. Retry to confirm settings are saved and the managed process exits.
automation.localService: Connect to an existing local service
automation.localRecommendation: Recommended: {{tokens}}K tokens. Budgets are estimates; load failures stop and report, without lowering a manual limit.

localErrors.invalid-model-endpoint: Use a valid loopback endpoint; managed startup requires HTTP.
localErrors.invalid-local-model-path: Provide absolute, existing paths for both server and weights.
localErrors.invalid-local-model-metadata: Could not read valid GGUF model metadata.
localErrors.local-model-unsupported: Resource estimates currently support Qwen3.5 GGUF weights.
localErrors.local-runtime-unavailable: llama-server cannot run. Check its version, architecture and dependencies.
localErrors.local-port-unavailable: The port is occupied. Stop the other process or choose another port.
localErrors.local-context-unsupported: Context exceeds the model or current resource budget. Select automatic or a smaller limit.
localErrors.local-service-unavailable: Cannot connect to local service {{endpoint}}; hardware has not been assessed. Download local resources and check to enable, or start your existing service and check its endpoint.
localErrors.local-service-context-unknown: Cannot confirm context, or it is below 32K. Check n_ctx in /props.
localErrors.local-memory-insufficient: Not enough available resources for 32K context. Free RAM or VRAM and retry.
localErrors.local-environment-failed: Environment checks failed. Check the local service, executable and weights.
localErrors.local-gpu-unavailable: No usable GPU detected. Check your GPU and driver; CPU fallback is disabled.
localErrors.local-vram-unknown: Free VRAM could not be confirmed. Check GPU drivers and detection tools, then retry.
localErrors.local-vram-insufficient: Free VRAM cannot support the minimum 32K context. Close GPU-heavy applications and retry; CPU fallback is disabled.
localErrors.local-download-failed: Download or installation failed. Check network, system proxy and directory permissions, then retry; verified files will be reused.
localErrors.local-download-unsupported: Automatic download supports Windows x64. Configure existing runtime and weights manually on this platform.
localErrors.local-download-size-mismatch: Downloaded size does not match; not installed. Please retry.
localErrors.local-download-hash-mismatch: Downloaded checksum does not match; not installed. Please retry.
localErrors.local-disk-insufficient: Insufficient disk space. Allow about 3.7 GB free space and retry.
localErrors.local-runtime-extract-failed: Runtime extraction failed. Check disk space, directory permissions and security software, then retry.

memorySettings.title: Personal profile
memorySettings.description: Control how Janus remembers and uses personal information. Disabling Personal profile stops personal capture, processing and chat recall while retaining existing data.
memorySettings.captureConversationsHint: Save recent Janus conversation records and propose personal memories. Explicit requests to remember remain available when this is off.
memorySettings.inferEngineeringHabitsHint: Infer attributable preferences from enabled project collection. Personal review is required; these memories are never published to project knowledge.
memorySettings.useInChatHint: Allow Janus to recall confirmed personal information, preferences and valid recent records.
memorySettings.retentionHint: Applies to new records only (30–90 days). Existing expiry dates and confirmed long-term memories are unchanged.
memorySettings.savedImmediately: Changes save immediately. Personal memories require human review; these settings do not enable local models or automatic admission.

personalBoard.description: Review what Janus remembers about you and keep it accurate.

automationExplain.title: Automatic processing
automationExplain.thresholdHint: Range 0.50–1.00; default 0.90. Higher values are stricter. Lowering this does not bypass source, revocation or conflict checks.
automationExplain.reevaluateHint: Only current below-threshold tasks are reevaluated. Saving alone does not rerun historical failures.
automationExplain.scoreMissing: This attempt did not record individual scores.
automationExplain.unknown: No explained result is available. Refresh the status.
automationExplain.unknownNext: Expand technical information for the original reason, or refresh.
automationExplain.score: Review scores did not meet the approval threshold.
automationExplain.scoreNext: Inspect the scores, add evidence or adjust the threshold before reevaluating.
automationExplain.source: Cited evidence does not qualify for automatic approval; it may contain only AI claims or unverifiable sources.
automationExplain.sourceNext: Inspect the original sources and review manually. Lowering the threshold cannot bypass this rule.
automationExplain.missing: The complete conversation is unavailable. Processing stopped at evidence validation.
automationExplain.missingNext: Recover evidence for this turn, then continue processing.
automationExplain.conflict: This candidate conflicts with, corrects or replaces existing knowledge.
automationExplain.conflictNext: Compare sources and existing knowledge, then review manually.
automationExplain.budget: Evidence or content exceeds processing limits.
automationExplain.budgetNext: Inspect the source and citations; review manually or narrow the content.
automationExplain.config: No usable model is configured for this stage.
automationExplain.configNext: Configure this stage in automation settings.
automationExplain.historical: This candidate is outside the current automatic processing scope.
automationExplain.historicalNext: Add it individually to automatic review, or review manually.
automationExplain.disabled: Automation is disabled. This candidate awaits manual review.
automationExplain.disabledNext: Review manually or enable automation in settings.
automationExplain.failed: A model call or processing step failed without a valid review result.
automationExplain.failedNext: Check the model connection and configuration, then retry.
automationExplain.pendingNext: Tasks run in order and update their results when complete.
automationExplain.completedNext: Inspect the output or candidates. Extraction completion does not mean approval.
automationExplain.cancelled: Inputs changed or sources were withdrawn; this task is no longer applicable.
automationExplain.cancelledNext: Inspect the current candidate and latest records.
automationExplain.manualNext: Inspect the original content and review manually.
automationExplain.unchanged: The item still needs attention. Inspect the reason.
automationExplain.auditUnknown: The detailed effect was not recorded. Inspect the saved content and technical information.
automationExplain.auditApplied: The candidate passed review and its content was written to the knowledge base.
automationExplain.auditRejected: The candidate was rejected and will not be used as confirmed knowledge.
automationExplain.auditProposed: Content entered the inbox and requires review before becoming confirmed knowledge.
automationExplain.auditCaptured: Source content was captured. Capture alone does not imply approval.
automationExplain.auditRevoked: Related content left the active view; historical records remain available.
automationExplain.auditWiki: The Wiki page was updated. Refer to the recorded version and content.
automationExplain.auditFailure: Processing did not complete. This event records the failure.
automationExplain.noContent: This historical event did not preserve readable content.
